title: The Last Room
desc: A short VR story: you walk through your grandparent's house one last time before it's sold. Hold the right object in each room and a memory comes back to life around you.
features: Six scenes, from the doorstep through the hallway and kitchen to the garden
Point at the glowing object in each room and hold the trigger to unlock a memory
Rooms change when a memory unlocks: lights turn golden, people and objects reappear
Ambient sound like a ticking clock, best played with headphones
